description.summary: You can decrease your caster’s size by up to two categories, to a minimum of Tiny.
description.value: You can decrease your caster’s size by up to two categories, to a minimum of Tiny. If the caster shrinks two sizes, its weight decreases by a factor of 16 and it gains a +4 size bonus to Dexterity, a –4 penalty to Strength, and a +2 bonus on attack rolls and to AC because of its decreased size. A Small humanoid caster whose size decreases to Diminutive has a space of 1 foot and a natural reach of 0 feet.
